subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should MiniMax Token Plan sub-agent workflows preserve the current AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md-only bootstrap boundary and use explicit plugin/skill/ClawHub surfaces, or should OpenClaw add a special Token Plan skill-inheritance path after live endpoint proof?
rationale: The requested fixes cross a documented provider endpoint contract and an intentional sub-agent context boundary, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Preserve boundary and prove endpoint
options.body: Keep sub-agent bootstrap limited to AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md, require live Token Plan endpoint proof, and route office generation through explicit skills/plugins or ClawHub surfaces.

options.title: Approve Token Plan inheritance
options.body: Create a maintainer-approved narrow inheritance or skill-filter contract for Token Plan sub-agents, with tests and docs defining why this exception is safe.

options.title: Document workaround only
options.body: Leave runtime behavior unchanged and document the `mmx` CLI workaround if maintainers decide Token Plan office workflows belong outside OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Preserve boundary and prove endpoint
recommendation.body: Keep sub-agent bootstrap limited to AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md, require live Token Plan endpoint proof, and route office generation through explicit skills/plugins or ClawHub surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Eva introduced the current sub-agent bootstrap boundary that maintainers must either preserve or explicitly alter.
